title: Malhotra ne Simran ka credit churaya... CEO ke saamne | Anhoni #shorts

characters.simran: Confident young woman, mid-20s, oval face, tan-brown skin, wavy shoulder-length black hair, small gold jhumka earrings, tan-brown formal blazer over a buttoned white shirt, maroon lanyard around neck, calm deadpan expression, subtle knowing half-smile
characters.malhotra: Grumpy khadoos manager, late-40s, round paunchy build, balding head with thin side hair, thick black moustache, reading glasses on nose-tip, light-grey formal shirt with a tight maroon tie, permanent frown, sweaty forehead

intro: Har office me ek Malhotra hota hai jo credit tumhara, blame bhi tumhara karta hai.
music_prompt: light quirky corporate background music, playful-tense deadpan, minimal ticking rhythm, no vocals

panels.text: Simran, deck raat ko bana dena. Kal meri presentation hai.
panels.prompt: Wide shot of a premium glass meeting room, Malhotra leaning back smug pointing at Simran, Simran standing with a laptop, city skyline behind glass; deadpan tension
Close-up on Simran at her cubicle at night, single desk lamp on, cold half-eaten dinner beside laptop, maroon lanyard visible, tired deadpan face; dark office

panels.text: 'Main' ne 3 hafte mehnat ki hai is project pe.
panels.prompt: Medium shot of Malhotra rehearsing in front of a mirror in the washroom, adjusting tie proudly, chest puffed, glasses on nose-tip; office corridor light

panels.text: Slide 7 pe abhi bhi mera naam hai... footer me.
panels.prompt: Over-shoulder close-up of Simran's laptop showing a slide, tiny author footer reading 'Prepared by: Simran', her finger hovering, faint half-smile; warm office light

panels.text: Agle din — CEO khud review meeting me aa gaya.
panels.prompt: Timestamp caption panel over a wide boardroom, a stern grey-haired CEO entering, Malhotra straightening up nervously with laptop, team seated; corporate tension

panels.text: Sir, yeh poora analysis maine akele banaya hai.
panels.prompt: Medium shot of Malhotra presenting confidently on a big screen, sweat starting on forehead, hand gesturing at slide; CEO watching from front row, blurred

panels.text: CEO slide 7 pe ruk kyun gaya...
panels.prompt: Close-up on Malhotra's frozen sweaty face, glasses slipping, eyes darting to the screen where a footer glows; harsh projector light on him

panels.text: CEO: 'Footer me toh Simran likha hai. Wo kahaan hai?'
panels.prompt: Caption panel over the projector screen zoomed on tiny footer 'Prepared by: Simran', CEO pointing a laser at it, whole room turning to look; deadpan

panels.text: Ji sir, main hi hoon. Baaki main samjhaati hoon.
panels.prompt: Close-up on Simran calmly standing up with her laptop, confident half-smile, gold jhumkas catching light, Malhotra out-of-focus deflating behind; satisfying deadpan

panels.text: Credit chor liya... par footer delete karna bhool gaya.
panels.prompt: Final caption panel over Simran presenting confidently to the CEO while Malhotra sinks into his chair behind; bold screenshot-worthy text, premium comic look

caption:
Malhotra ne poora credit le liya... bas slide 7 ka footer bhool gaya. 😌
CEO ke ek sawaal ne game palat di — ab dekhna kya hota hai.
Part 2 ke liye Follow karo — Malhotra ka appraisal wala scene aa raha hai. 👀
Tag wo colleague jiska credit hamesha koi aur le jaata hai.
(Yeh kahani kaalpanik hai, kisi vyakti ya company se sambandh nahi.)
